summary: Universal Safety Products filed an 8-K disclosing an amended and restated Securities Purchase Agreement with SJC Lending LLC, restating a June 12, 2026 agreement for convertible promissory notes. The notes total up to $2.65 million principal for a purchase price of up to $2.5 million, issued in three tranches: $1,060,000 face for $1,000,000 at the initial closing, $530,000 face for $500,000 on July 29, 2026, and a $1,060,000 face final tranche due within 30 days of SEC-declared resale registration effectiveness. Conversion above 19.99% of shares outstanding on the initial closing date requires stockholder approval. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution from note conversions and the stockholder vote.
